text:
frida: Drafting relnotes + changelog for Routing v2 + Dedicated migration notes. Main PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6120. Need: concise changelog bullet, migration checklist, and SDK snippet parity. PTAL
alex: quick skim: looks good. callouts: (1) include a tiny "how to pin a variant" example for Dedicated (API + Console), (2) mention that fallback to quantized variants can slightly change punctuation in outputs
maya: added API pin example and a screenshot note for the Console flow. put a short Known Issues bullet about punctuation drift and token offsets for streaming embeddings. PTAL
frida: thanks. can someone validate the JS streaming example? I updated it but not 100% sure on the method name changes
ci-bot: snippet-linter: JS/streaming.md -> warning: uses client.generateStream (deprecated). New method: client.text.createStream. Also markdown-lint: MD012 multiple consecutive blank lines in relnotes.md line 18
alex: fixing the JS snippet to client.text.createStream now
maya: fixed lint and pushed. also added a small "what to expect" one-liner: brief latency increase during prefix-warm when caches cold
ops: fyi ops request: include recommended rollout cadence and rollback triggers in relnotes so SEs have a playbook. Suggest: canary 5% 3h, 25% 12h, 75% 24h; rollback on error rate > 1% sustained 5m or p95 latency +40%
frida: added rollout cadence + ops playbook snippet (example Prometheus alert rules). Included an example for rolling back a rollout via admin API
ci-bot: linkcheck: /guides/dedicated/pin-variant -> 404; suggested replacement: /guides/dedicated/variant-pinning. External link https://thirdparty.example.com/quant-readme -> 410 (archived)
maya: swapped internal link and removed dead external link. put a small compatibility table inline instead
alex: small code nit  Python snippet imports from "redwood.sdk.v0"  should be "from redwood import Client" (v1). Also JS snippet still used await client.generate in non-stream example  update to client.text.generate
frida: corrected Python import and JS non-stream. re-ran snippet tests
ci-bot: snippet-tests: streaming example flaky (timeout). Retry scheduled
ci-bot: snippet-tests: passed on retry. deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/6120/relnotes-routing-v2
ops: add warmup guidance for customers switching variants at scale: recommend ramped warmup at 5 RPS per GPU, monitor 429s, backoff on errors. Add a sample warmup loop
maya: added warmup guidance and this safe warmup example:
```bash
# safe warmup loop: 5 RPS per GPU, backoff on 429
for i in {1..60}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate \
    -d '{"model":"kestrel-13b","input":"warmup"}' || true
  sleep 0.2
done
```
frida: added a tiny preflight eval checklist: 1) run canonical eval set, 2) compare metrics against baseline, 3) smoke test streaming & embeddings. included an eval curl snippet for customers
alex: LGTM. editorial: shorten changelog bullet to one liner: "Routing v2: adaptive routing, variant pinning, and graceful quantized fallbacks (see docs)"
frida: updated changelog bullet. planning to merge in 10m and schedule publish 08:30 UTC. will post to #announcements and #support with summary and migration checklist. thanks all! :shipit:
